mindset: Custom `TextDecrypt` component: I designed a lightweight animation that reveals letters one by one. Goal: bring some dynamism to the page while keeping the component reusable and performant.
projectsButton: CSS animated button with a scrolling text effect.
contactButton: Accessibility-focused button: hover and focus states meet WCAG AA contrast standards and are fully keyboard-accessible.
layout: Responsive layout built with Flexbox and Tailwind breakpoints. Two clear columns on desktop, simplified stacked layout on mobile.
resumeData: All data related to my resume is externalized in `resume.json`. This separates content from presentation and makes it reusable elsewhere.
